Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Mornington

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Mornington. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Mornington sits close to the water, so we know what salt air and wind do to metal roofs, flashings and gutters, and we recommend materials that stand up to it. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Mornington: What We Commonly See

Mornington's roofs range from heritage roofing on its older established homes through to COLORBOND® on newer coastal builds and holiday homes. Exposed sites near the bay and the cliffs cop strong winds and salt spray, which lift and crack ridge capping and corrode metal fixings and gutters over time.

The work we are called out for most in Mornington is refixing loose ridge capping, re-roofing worn-out roofs, fixing leaks around flashings and valleys, and replacing tired or rusted guttering. Keeping a roof in good order here protects both the home and its street appeal, which matters in a sought-after coastal town.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Mornington

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Mornington homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and well suited to bayside weather, and we use quality fixings, flashings and gutters that stand up to salt air.

Many older homes were built with roofs that contain asbestos cement sheeting. If that is your roof, we handle safe asbestos roof removal and replacement and finish the job in new COLORBOND® steel. We also convert older roofs to metal with our tile to tin service, and we will tell you honestly which option suits your home.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Mornington

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that take the most punishment near the water: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. Salt air eats through poorly finished metal quickly, so we trace leaks back to the real source and fix them properly rather than patching the ceiling stain.

We replace guttering, downpipes and fascia capping in COLORBOND® steel, from a single damaged section through to a complete gutter replacement, and we carry out gutter repairs where a repair is all that is needed. We remove the old guttering cleanly and leave the site tidy.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Mornington

Your quote depends on what your roof actually needs. Roof size, pitch and access, the type of steel and colour you choose, and how much plumbing work is involved are the main factors. We give you a clear written quote after an on-site inspection, so you know what you are paying for before any work starts.

Our Mornington Roofing Process

We start with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. For a re-roof we strip the old roof, prepare the framing, fit insulation and sarking where needed, then re-sheet in new COLORBOND® steel with fresh flashings, ridge capping, gutters and downpipes. We leave the site clean and tidy when we are done.

Why Mornington Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, so your job is done to standard and you are covered. As a local, family run business we treat your home the way we would treat our own, turn up when we say we will, and give honest advice rather than a hard sell. Mornington Roofing FAQs

Does living near the bay affect my roof?

Yes. Salt air corrodes metal roofs, fixings, flashings and gutters faster than it does inland, so coastal homes benefit from quality COLORBOND® materials and regular checks.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
